fusions.name: Wring It Out
fusions.desc: Grips a faltering enemy and wrenches, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Grasping Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a grasping barb that deals 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Come Hither
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Grip
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
